Summarize the concept of attention in transformers.

<think>

In the Transformer architecture, **attention** (specifically **Self-Attention**) is the core mechanism that allows the model to weigh the importance of different words (or tokens) in a sequence relative to one another.

Unlike previous neural network architectures (like RNNs) that processed data sequentially and often struggled with long-range dependencies, self-attention enables the model to understand the relationship between any two tokens in a sentence simultaneously, regardless of their distance.
